fullContentHtml:
Indian Army Dental Corps Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Armed Forces Medical Services (AFMS) will release the notification for the post of Dental Corps on the official website of Indian Army. This recruitment has been issued for 37 posts. Online applying process for Indian Army Dental Corps Recruitment 2026 has started from 22 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 22 October 2026. Those Candidates Are Interested in the following recruitment can apply online from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 200/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online (Male)
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Indian Army Dental Corps Online Form 2026?

Indian Army Dental Corps Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
